Conflicts.Title: Conflicts
Conflicts.Empty: No conflicts. Nothing needs your decision.
Conflicts.NoDetail: Select a conflict to compare its versions.
Conflicts.Reason.CreateCreate: A file with this name was created on this computer and in OneDrive, and CloudSync cannot show that the two are the same, so it cannot safely decide which one should win.
Conflicts.Reason.ModifyModify: This file was changed locally and in OneDrive. CloudSync cannot safely determine which version should win.
Conflicts.Reason.RenameRename: This item was moved to different locations on this computer and in OneDrive.
Conflicts.Reason.KeepDelete: One side changed this file while the other removed it.
Conflicts.Reason.KeepDelete.Local: This file was removed locally while OneDrive changed it. CloudSync cannot tell whether to delete it or keep the change.
Conflicts.Reason.KeepDelete.Remote: This file was removed in OneDrive while it changed locally. CloudSync cannot tell whether to delete it or keep the change.
Conflicts.Reason.Unknown: CloudSync detected competing changes to this item and cannot safely decide which one should win.
Conflicts.Recovery: Recovery available: resolving never deletes the other version straight away, so you can undo a wrong choice. Keep both is the safest option.
Conflicts.Confirm: Apply "{action}" to {count} conflict(s)? The other version stays recoverable.
